mapper.update: UPDATE case_mirror_outbox SET payload_json = #{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = 'pending', available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_until = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND operation = 'upsert' AND status IN ('pending', 'failed')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_mirror_outbox WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND operation = 'upsert' AND status = 'pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_mirror_outbox(case_id, operation, payload_json) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{operation}, #{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_id, operation, payload_json, attempts FROM case_mirror_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE case_mirror_outbox SET status = 'failed', lease_owner = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, available_at = #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}
